name: My Pet Novice & Magician
original_name: マイペットノービス&マジシャン
source:
Two girls set on adventure and get attacked during assault on a city. They can't escape this carnal feast.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两名女孩踏上冒险之旅，在攻打一座城市时遭到袭击。她们无法逃脱这场肉欲盛宴。
